title: Decision: Attendance and Participation by International Organisations, Specialised Agencies, and Other International Bodies at the Thirtieth Session of the Conference of the States Parties
text:
CS-2025-5379(E) distributed 26/11/2025 
*CS-2025-5379.E* 
 
 
OPCW 
Conference of the States Parties 
Thirtieth Session 
24 – 28 November 2025 
C-30/DEC.2 
24 November 2025 
Original: ENGLISH 
DECISION 
ATTENDANCE AND PARTICIPATION BY INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS, 
SPECIALISED AGENCIES, AND OTHER INTERNATIONAL BODIES AT THE 
THIRTIETH SESSION OF THE CONFERENCE OF THE STATES PARTIES 
 
The Conference of the States Parties, 
 
Bearing in mind Rules 31 and 32 of its Rules of Procedure, 
 
Hereby: 
 
Approves the attendance and participation, at the Thirtieth Session of the Conference of the 
States Parties, of the international organisations, specialised agencies, and other international 
bodies listed in the Annex hereto. 
 
 
 
Annex:  List of International Organisations, Specialised Agencies, and Other International 
Bodies Entitled to Attend and Participate in the Thirtieth Session of the Conference 
of the States Parties  

C-30/DEC.2 
Annex 
page 2 
 
 
Annex 
LIST OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS, SPECIALISED AGENCIES,  
AND OTHER INTERNATIONAL BODIES ENTITLED TO ATTEND AND 
PARTICIPATE IN THE THIRTIETH SESSION OF THE CONFERENCE  
OF THE STATES PARTIES 
 
1. 
European Union (EU) 
2. 
European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Cooperation (Europol) 
3. 
International Criminal Police Organization (INTERPOL) 
4. 
North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) 
5. 
Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) 
6. 
Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) 
7. 
United Nations Interregional Crime and Justice Research Institute (UNICRI)
